label: DATING AGAIN

points.heading: You see who he really is
points.body: Consistency shows over weeks, not days.
points.panel: Notice how he acts on the third and tenth date.

points.heading: You stay yourself
points.body: Going slowly keeps your own life full and steady.
points.panel: “I like you, and I’m enjoying taking our time.”

points.heading: Less anxiety, more fun
points.body: No rush means less pressure on every text and date.
points.panel: “Am I enjoying this, or just worrying about it?”

points.heading: Trust builds naturally
points.panel: Notice whether he does what he says he’ll do.

points.heading: The right person won’t mind
points.body: Someone serious will be happy to go at a good pace.
points.panel: “I like to get to know someone properly.”

close.save: Save this for your next date.

caption:
After a breakup, it can be tempting to rush into something new, or to avoid dating completely. There’s a middle path.

Slow dating gives you time to see who someone really is, while staying yourself. Here are five reasons it works, and why the right person won’t mind waiting.

Save this for your next date, and follow @roundabloom for more gentle steps.
